description_en: Creates an egress proxy IP pool under a specified egress proxy gateway
description_zh: 在指定的出口代理网关下创建出口代理地址池
kebab_example: aliyun epg create-egress-proxy-ip-pool --egress-proxy-gateway-id epg-gw80bb6a94f835db0000 --egress-proxy-ip-pool-name testIpPool --address-type Intranet --zone-mappings '[{"IpAddresses":[{}],"IpCount":12,"ZoneId":"cn-shanghai-b","VSwitchId":"vsw-0jl8x3ridfqbikax5o0000"}]' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateEgressProxyIpPool

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

Note If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the client token. The RequestId of each API request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端 Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符。

说明 若您未指定，则系统自动使用 API 请求的 RequestId 作为 ClientToken 标识。每次 API 请求的 RequestId 不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs only a dry run and does not create the egress proxy IP pool. The system checks whether the required parameters are specified, the request format is valid, and the service limits are met. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the DryRunOperation error code is returned.

false (default): performs a dry run and sends the actual request. If the request passes the dry run, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会创建出口代理地址池。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误；如果检查通过，则返回错误码 DryRunOperation。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回 HTTP 2xx 状态码并直接执行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The ID of the egress proxy gateway to which the egress proxy IP pool belongs
parameters.help_zh: 出口代理地址池所属的出口代理网关 ID
parameters.name: egress_proxy_gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the egress proxy address pool. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, start with a letter or a Chinese character, and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 出口代理地址池名称。长度为 2~128 个字符，必须以英文字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: egress_proxy_ip_pool_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the egress proxy IP pool. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length, and can contain letters and digits. It can also contain commas (,), periods (.), semicolons (;), forward slashes (/), at signs (@), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 出口代理地址池描述。长度为 2~256 个字符，支持中文和英文字母，可包含数字、半角逗号（,）、半角句号（.）、半角分号（;）、正斜线（/）、at 符号（@）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The address type of the egress proxy IPAM pool. The address type cannot be modified after creation. Valid values:

Intranet: private endpoint in a private network. Only private network IPv4 addresses (PrivateIpv4Address) in a vSwitch are supported.

Internet: public IP address. Only EIPs (EipAllocationId) are supported
parameters.help_zh:
出口代理地址池的地址类型。地址类型在创建后不可修改。取值：

Intranet：私网地址。仅支持添加交换机内的私网 IPv4 地址（PrivateIpv4Address）。

Internet：公网地址。仅支持添加弹性公网 IP（EipAllocationId）
parameters.name: address_type

parameters.help_en:
The scheduling algorithm for egress IP addresses, which specifies how an egress IP address is selected from the IP pool. Valid values:

Random (default): random scheduling.

ConsistentHash: consistent hashing. If this value is used, you must specify the HashFactor parameter
parameters.help_zh:
出口 IP 的调度算法，即从地址池中选择出口 IP 的方式。取值：

Random（默认值）：随机调度。

ConsistentHash：一致性哈希。取值为 ConsistentHash 时，必须指定哈希因子 HashFactor
parameters.name: scheduler

parameters.help_en:
The hash factor used for consistent hashing. This parameter is required when the Scheduler parameter is set to ConsistentHash. Valid values:

SourceIP: source IP address.

FiveTuple: 5-tuple.

HttpHeader: HTTP request header. If this value is used, you must also specify the corresponding HTTP request header name
parameters.help_zh:
一致性哈希调度所使用的哈希因子。当调度算法 Scheduler 取值为 ConsistentHash 时必填。取值：

SourceIP：源 IP。

FiveTuple：五元组。

HttpHeader：HTTP 请求头。取值为 HttpHeader 时，还需指定对应的 HTTP 请求头名称
parameters.name: hash_factor

parameters.help_en: The name of the custom hash request header. This parameter is required when the HashFactor parameter is set to HttpHeader. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 自定义哈希请求头名称。当哈希因子 HashFactor 取值为 HttpHeader 时必填。长度为 1~128 个字符
parameters.name: hash_header_name

fields.help_en: The ID of the elastic IP address (EIP). Specify this parameter only when the AddressType parameter is set to Internet
fields.help_zh: 弹性公网 IP（EIP）实例 ID。仅当 AddressType 取值为 Internet 时填写
fields.name: eip_allocation_id

fields.help_en: The private network IPv4 address. The address must be an active address in the corresponding vSwitch CIDR block. Specify this parameter only when the AddressType parameter is set to Intranet
fields.help_zh: 私网 IPv4 地址。需为对应交换机网段内的可用地址，仅当 AddressType 取值为 Intranet 时填写
fields.name: private_ipv4_address

fields.help_en:
The list of IP addresses. You can specify up to 100 IP addresses in each active zone.

If the AddressType parameter is set to Internet (public IP address), specify EipAllocationId.

If the AddressType parameter is set to Intranet (private endpoint in a private network), specify PrivateIpv4Address
fields.help_zh:
IP 地址列表。每个可用区最多指定 100 个 IP 地址。

当 AddressType 取值为 Internet（公网地址）时，填写 EipAllocationId。

当 AddressType 取值为 Intranet（私网地址）时，填写 PrivateIpv4Address
fields.name: ip_addresses

fields.help_en:
The number of private IPv4 addresses to be automatically allocated. This parameter takes effect only when the AddressType parameter is set to Intranet. The system automatically allocates the specified number of private IPv4 addresses in the vSwitch of the zone.

Note If you specify both PrivateIpv4Address in IpAddresses and IpCount, the number of specified PrivateIpv4Address values cannot exceed the value of IpCount
fields.help_zh:
自动分配的私网 IPv4 地址数量。仅当 AddressType 取值为 Intranet 时生效，系统会在该可用区对应的交换机内自动分配相应数量的私网 IPv4 地址。

说明 若同时指定 IpAddresses 中的 PrivateIpv4Address 与 IpCount，则指定的 PrivateIpv4Address 数量不能超过 IpCount
fields.name: ip_count

fields.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch in the zone. Private IPv4 addresses are allocated from the CIDR block of the vSwitch
fields.help_zh: 可用区对应的交换机 ID。私网 IPv4 地址将从该交换机所属的网段中分配
fields.name: vswitch_id

fields.help_en: The zone ID. You can call the DescribeZones operation to query the zone information corresponding to the zone ID
fields.help_zh: 可用区 ID。您可以通过调用 DescribeZones 接口获取可用区 ID 对应的可用区信息
fields.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The mappings between zones and vSwitches, which are used to specify the zones, vSwitches, and IP addresses for the deployment of the egress proxy IP pool
parameters.help_zh: 可用区与交换机的映射列表，用于指定出口代理地址池部署的可用区、交换机及其 IP 地址
parameters.name: zone_mappings

fields.help_en: The tag key. The key can be up to 128 characters in length, and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签键。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. The value can be up to 256 characters in length, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签值。最多支持256个字符，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
fields.name: value

EgressProxyIpPoolId.description_en: The ID of the created egress proxy IP pool
EgressProxyIpPoolId.description_zh: 创建的出口代理地址池 ID
